verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents OpenHands generating or running tests to validate its own changes before proposing them. The closest items are adjacent, not this capability: the critic produces model-predicted quality scores rather than executed tests, and the CI-fix and security automations open PRs without any documented test-generation or test-run step.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent automatically generate and run tests to validate its own code changes before proposing them
